title: Review of FCH protocells (SIBW): replicated on seed 7 with the chi=0 control; Supported for S, I, B, W
summary: I looked at the claim's sheets and tracks, then re-ran world.py on seed 7 and world_chi0.py on seed 7 (100 frames, t=800). From white noise five closed bilayer rings form by t~32; four keep a solute-filled lumen to t=800 at 17-33x the outside per lumen (lumen_contrast.py), against 1.1-1.2 with the barrier ablated (author's contrast.py gives 23.6 vs 1.16 at t=800). The fifth ring fuses with an open bilayer strand at t~180-450, becomes an elongated vesicle and then a multilamellar onion, and its lumen closes at t~640 (lumens 5 -> 4). Two open strands never close. The u ring has rim/core 2.27, rim/outside 29.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0 is white noise over the whole domain; rings appear by t=32
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png: four vesicles persist unchanged in place from t=32 to t=800 (FACTS: 6 persistent tracks)
observations.B: rerun/seed7/FACTS.md: amphiphile u ring rim/core 2.27, rim/outside 29 (25/38 individuals membrane-like); the lumen is chemically distinct (solute) as well
observations.W: contrast_per_lumen.txt: each of the 4 surviving lumens holds 16.9-33.4x the outside from t=80 to t=800; rerun_chi0/seed7 (my run, barrier ablated) gives 1.1-1.2 by t=800, below 2 after t~80

seeds_run.result: pass (4 of 5 vesicles hold contents; 1 lost by fusion into an onion)

not_checked: 1.5x resolution (I looked at the author's pack_res15/seed0/sheet.png, which keeps 7 solute-filled lumens to t=800, but did not re-run it)
verdicts.limitation: The solute is passive (the membrane does not feel it) and is made only by the bilayer, so containment is of a tracer, not of chemistry the vesicle uses. Fusion with open strands destroys contents (1 of 5 vesicles on seed 7, as on the author's seed 1), and background solute rises slowly through the run. Nothing divides, grows or repairs here; a Laplacian-only twin was not run.
